description_en: Modifies the information about a custom monitoring view
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-performance-view --db-cluster-id amv-bp1ub9grke10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --view-name Custom-All_metrics-2_columns-Linked --view-detail '{"ChartLinked":true,"Categories":[{"Category":"Node","Keys":[{"KeyName":"AnalyticDB_CPU","Selected":true}]}],"ChartsPerLine":3}' --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPerformanceView
